verdict.rationale: Aleph's own marketing says it puts "routine financial reporting and closing processes on autopilot" and offers "reporting automation" with sync workflows, which implies recurring automated reporting. Its mapping agents also monitor source data 24/7. However, nothing documents a user-facing scheduler for defining recurring jobs or workflows. missing for 10: explicit user-configurable scheduling (cron or interval) of jobs or agent workflows, documentation of schedule management and run history, API or programmatic scheduling, independent or hands-on corroboration.
